title: slice run re-verifies a head changed after a review FAIL
body:
Outcome: after a review FAIL and a lead fix commit, `krn slice run` notices the head changed since its verify stage and reruns `krn verify` on the new head before the second review attempt, instead of the lead running verify by hand.
Evidence: #209: journal stayed at stage review after the fixup; the lead ran `bin/krn verify --base bb52ea9 --observer test/deliver/delivery.test.ts` manually (.krn/runs/lead/main-red-hygiene/verify2.log) before rerunning slice.
Proof: an observer changes the worktree head after a recorded review FAIL and asserts slice runs verify on the new head before calling review.
